runs.failure_point: Email-only grep hits reached four of ten qualifying matters; it opened one of them and added three that do not qualify.

first_error.stage: Search file contents for request keywords
first_error.why: Its keyword greps returned email files only and reached four of the ten qualifying matters; it did not search file names or scan document text, so six never surfaced.

other_errors.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
other_errors.why: The grep listed three more qualifying matters, but the emails and folders it chose next left them out and it never opened them.

runs.failure_point: Most qualifying matters were found, but one never surfaced, one was passed over for a different matter, one was read and excluded, and eight others were added.

first_error.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
first_error.why: Its store-wide content scans timed out (here and at [19]-[20]) and its other searches matched file names only, so one qualifying matter whose documents carry no such names never surfaced.

other_errors.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
other_errors.why: The file-name search listed another qualifying matter, but it read a different matter of the same client and never opened that one.
It read one qualifying matter's memo and excluded the matter as only a recommendation to engage.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Read documents picked from the file listing → Scan document text with an extraction script → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Write the response → Check or revise the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: A folder-restricted scan missed six qualifying matters; the answer adds eight that do not qualify.

first_error.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
first_error.why: After the store-wide scan timed out it restricted the retry to folders with matching names, which missed six qualifying matters whose documents sit in other folders; it never searched file names across the store.

other_errors.why: It listed eight other matters as qualifying.

divergence: All three runs failed, each with an over-inclusive answer. They split on how many qualifying matters surfaced: T0's greps returned email files only and reached four of ten; T2's retry scan was restricted to matching folder names and missed six; T1's file-name search reached nine while its content scans timed out before the tenth. All three then counted extra matters as qualifying at the write stage.
